_meta.provenance: research-derived model, NOT live coverage and NOT an opportunity feed
caveats: This models a RESEARCH FINDING about a page, not a set of live opportunity records.
No individual opportunity record is invented: there are no posted dates, close dates, opportunity numbers, award amounts or application URLs here, because none were captured.
Eligibility strings below are as captured by the Gate 78R read of the page. They were reported in quotes by that read but have NOT been re-verified against each programme's primary notice.
Therefore every eligibility string must be treated as a research lead requiring primary-source confirmation before any eligibility or exclusion conclusion is published to a customer.
Programme currency is unknown. Federal programmes open and close; this is a snapshot of a page as read on the capture date, not a claim that any programme is currently accepting applications.
The page is titled for state tribes but every programme on it is federal. That mismatch is the finding.

source.source_name: SC Native American Affairs — Grants for State Tribes
source.source_owner: SC Commission for Community Advancement and Engagement
source.note: Host page is an SC state domain; every programme listed is federally funded. Lane must be assigned per programme, not inherited from the host.

recognition_context.note: A secondary source reported nine state-recognized tribes; the agency page enumerates ten. The agency page is treated as authoritative and the discrepancy is recorded, not resolved.
